I found Alice’s body in Weapons just now and reported immediately. My route was electrical → medbay → back through electrical → security → weapons. 

I saw Charlie in electrical early, around ticks 2-4. Then I saw Diana enter medbay from upper_engine at tick 7 and she was still in medbay tick 8. I didn’t see Alice alive this round, and I didn’t see anyone else in or near Weapons when I found the body.

I can back up Eve's early route. I started in Medbay, then headed to Electrical and saw Eve there around ticks 2-4. After that, I just passed through Security and went straight down to Navigation to do my Chart Course task. I didn't see Alice or anyone else after leaving Electrical, so I was totally isolated down in Nav when the kill must have happened. I haven't seen anyone heading toward Weapons either. Let's hear where everyone else was.

My route was Oxygen → Upper Engine → Medbay → Electrical. I didn’t see Alice at all.

I saw Eve in Medbay around tick 7, and then I saw her leave Medbay toward Electrical at tick 8, so that part of her route matches what she said. Bob came into Medbay from Upper Engine at tick 10, then later entered Electrical from Medbay around tick 13, and he was still with me in Electrical at tick 14.

So Bob was near me late, which makes me think he probably didn’t do a Weapons kill right before the report unless the timing is weird. I don’t have enough to clear anyone fully, but Eve’s route checks out with what I saw, and Bob’s late position was Electrical with me. I’d like to hear Bob and Frank’s routes, especially whether anyone was near Weapons/Security.

I don’t have much direct info, unfortunately. My route was Security → Navigation → Storage → Lower Engine, and I didn’t encounter anyone the whole round — no Alice, no body, no one passing me.

One thing to note: Charlie says he passed through Security and went to Navigation, but I never saw him in either place, so our timing must not have overlapped. I’m not calling that a contradiction by itself, just saying I can’t confirm it.

For the Weapons body: Eve’s report location makes sense with her route, and Diana seems to confirm Eve was around Medbay/Electrical earlier. Diana also puts Bob in Medbay/Electrical late, but Bob still needs to give his full route. Right now I don’t have enough to hard accuse anyone. I’d like to hear Bob before deciding, but if nothing new comes up I’m leaning skip.

My route was Lower Engine → Upper Engine → Oxygen → back through Upper Engine → Medbay → Electrical.

I saw Diana leave Oxygen toward Upper Engine around tick 4, then I saw her again in Medbay around tick 10, and later she left Electrical toward Security around tick 14. I never saw Alice alive, and I didn’t see Charlie, Eve, or Frank at all this round.

Diana’s account of me being Medbay/Electrical late is right, and from my point of view Diana’s route also seems consistent. For the Weapons body, I think the only people with real opportunity from the stories are probably Eve as reporter, Charlie if he passed Security/near Weapons, or Frank since he started Security/Nav side. But I don’t see a hard contradiction yet. Frank not seeing Charlie is worth noting, but timing could explain it.

I’m leaning skip unless someone has stronger evidence, because voting wrong here feels risky.

I’ll add my read now that everyone’s spoken: Diana and Bob seem mutually consistent late in Medbay/Electrical, and Diana also confirms part of my route. Frank being Security/Nav side but not seeing Charlie isn’t a hard contradiction because timing could easily miss.

The only real gap is Charlie after Electrical — he says he went through Security to Navigation, but no one confirms him there, and that path is near Weapons. Frank also started on that side, so he technically had early opportunity too, but his route going away to Storage/Lower makes some sense.

I’m not fully confident enough to hard push, but if we vote, my strongest suspicion is Charlie based on opportunity near Weapons after I last saw him. If people think that’s too thin, I’m okay skipping rather than risking a bad vote.

To address Frank not seeing me: Frank, you started in Security and moved down to Nav, then Storage and Lower Engine. I started over in Medbay and Electrical. By the time I actually reached Security and Nav to do my task, you were already way ahead of me on your route towards the bottom of the ship. It makes perfect sense that our paths didn't cross because you cleared out of that area before I arrived.

Eve, I understand why I might look like a suspect since I ended up on that side of the map without a buddy, but I was just isolated in Nav doing my Chart Course task. If we're strictly talking about opportunity, Frank started right next to Weapons in Security, and you ended up right in Weapons yourself. A self-report isn't out of the question either. 

That being said, I'm not going to hard accuse anyone when the timing is this loose. I agree with Bob and Frank — voting here without concrete evidence is too risky. I'm going to skip, and I suggest we all do the same so we don't accidentally throw out a Goose.

My info is the same but now with Bob’s route it lines up pretty cleanly: I went Oxygen → Upper Engine → Medbay → Electrical. I never saw Alice alive.

I saw Eve in Medbay around tick 7, and saw her leave toward Electrical at tick 8. Bob came into Medbay from Upper Engine around tick 10, then later came into Electrical from Medbay around tick 13 and was with me there at tick 14. Bob also confirms seeing me around Oxygen/Medbay/Electrical, so I think Bob and I are fairly consistent with each other.

For the Weapons kill, I don’t think Bob is likely based on timing and location. Eve did report the body, so self-report is possible in theory, but her earlier route matched what I saw. That leaves the right side people as the main question: Charlie passing Security/Nav area, and Frank starting Security/Nav side. Frank not seeing Charlie is a little notable, but the timing explanation is plausible.

I don’t have enough to confidently vote Charlie or Frank here. If everyone else is unsure too, I’m okay with skip rather than risking voting out a Goose.

I’ll restate my route clearly: I was Security → Navigation → Storage → Lower Engine. I never went into Weapons, and I didn’t see Alice alive or find the body. I also didn’t see Charlie in Security/Nav, but I agree the timing explanation is possible if I had already left before he got there.

From the stories, Bob and Diana line up pretty well with each other late, and Diana partially confirms Eve’s route. That makes me less suspicious of Bob/Diana right now. The main uncertainty is still Charlie being unconfirmed near Security/Nav and Eve as the reporter in Weapons, but I don’t think either is strong enough to vote on.

I’m not comfortable pushing a vote here without a real contradiction. My vote is probably skip unless someone has something stronger.

I’ll keep my stance the same. My route was Lower Engine → Upper Engine → Oxygen → Upper Engine → Medbay → Electrical. I saw Diana’s movement from Oxygen to Upper Engine early, then saw her in Medbay around tick 10, and later she left Electrical toward Security around tick 14.

Diana’s story lines up with what I saw, and she also places me late in Medbay/Electrical, so I don’t think either of us are good suspects for a Weapons kill. Eve’s route is partly backed by Diana too, though self-report is always technically possible.

The only uncertainty is still the right side: Charlie says he went Security/Nav, Frank says he started Security/Nav but didn’t see him. That could just be timing, and I don’t think it’s strong enough to vote someone out.

I’m leaning skip here. We should keep an eye on Charlie/Frank/Eve routes next round, but I don’t want to risk ejecting a Goose on weak info.

Thanks for sharing that, Frank. Yeah, I can confirm your sighting. I started down in security, then passed through electrical where I actually saw Bob alive and doing his thing. I didn't stick around—I went straight into medbay for a task, and then moved to upper engine where I bumped into you. After that, I headed up through oxygen and cafeteria, and ended up in weapons doing asteroids. 

Since Bob was definitely alive when I passed through electrical, the killer must have caught him after I left. Frank, you came from the left side. That leaves Diana and Eve. We really need to hear your routes—one of you must have gone to electrical while I was heading up the left side of the ship.

My route was medbay -> cafeteria -> oxygen -> upper engine -> lower engine. I never went into electrical this round.

What I can confirm: I saw Charlie in electrical very early, around ticks 3-4. Then I saw Diana in medbay around ticks 7-8, which is right next to electrical. Later, around tick 22, I saw Charlie enter oxygen from upper engine, which lines up with Charlie saying they went up that side.

So from my info, Charlie definitely had early electrical presence, but their later path seems to match. Diana was the only person I personally saw near the medbay/electrical area after that early window. I need to hear Diana’s exact route, because if Bob died in electrical after Charlie left, Diana had the closest opportunity from what I saw.

My route was cafeteria -> weapons -> security -> navigation -> storage. I never entered electrical or medbay this round.

What I saw: Eve was in medbay around tick 7. Bob was alive in medbay around tick 10, then I saw Bob alive in electrical around ticks 13-14. So Bob definitely died after tick 14.

That matters because Charlie’s “I saw Bob alive early and left” lines up with Bob still being alive later, but it doesn’t clear Charlie completely. Frank says Charlie came into upper engine from medbay around tick 22, and Eve says Charlie went into oxygen from upper engine around tick 22 too. So Charlie’s route is at least placing them near medbay/electrical again later, after Bob was alive in electrical.

Eve also had medbay presence early, and I saw that myself. But Eve’s later route sounds left side, not electrical. Frank found or knew about Bob in electrical and called it, so I don’t think that’s a hard clear but it’s useful info.

From my POV, the most suspicious thing is Charlie being connected to electrical/medbay multiple times and being the last person with a route that could pass near Bob after tick 14. I’m leaning Charlie unless someone has stronger timing.

I want to point out the big contradiction: Eve says she saw Diana in medbay around tick 7-8, but Diana says she never entered medbay or electrical. Diana also says she saw Eve in medbay and Bob in medbay/electrical while claiming her route was cafeteria -> weapons -> security -> navigation -> storage. I don’t see how she has those sightings without being around medbay/electrical.

Charlie was definitely near electrical early and came from medbay into upper engine at tick 22, so I agree Charlie isn’t fully cleared. But Diana’s story has the clearest hole to me right now. I’m leaning Diana unless someone can explain how her vision checks out.

Frank is absolutely spot on. I was listening to Diana's speech and thinking the exact same thing. 

Diana, you claim you were on the complete opposite side of the ship—cafeteria, weapons, security, nav, storage—yet you somehow have exact timings for Eve and Bob in medbay and electrical? That is physically impossible. You cannot see into medbay or electrical from the right side of the map. You are entirely making up those sightings, or you are lying about your route because you killed Bob there and need an alibi.

Notice how she immediately tries to pin it on me right after telling that impossible story? My route has been corroborated by *both* Eve and Frank—they both saw me moving up the left side exactly when I said I did. 

Diana is caught in a blatant lie. Her story physically does not work with the map. I am 100% voting Diana here, and I highly recommend everyone else does the same.

I want to be very clear: I personally saw Diana inside medbay at ticks 7-8. Not near it, not passing by on the right side — in medbay. So Diana saying she never entered medbay is directly false from my POV.

Also, her claimed route doesn’t explain how she saw Bob in medbay/electrical with those timings. That sounds like she’s trying to place herself away from the kill while still having info she shouldn’t have.

Charlie was in electrical early, yes, but I also saw Charlie later going from upper engine into oxygen, which matches the left-side route. Frank also saw Charlie around upper engine. Diana is the one with the hard contradiction.

I’m voting Diana.

I need to correct the misunderstanding here: when I said I never entered medbay or electrical, I meant I did not go inside those rooms. My sightings came from being near the connected areas — cafeteria/medbay side early, and security/electrical side later. So yes, I could see Eve in medbay and Bob in medbay/electrical without actually doing a task in those rooms.

Eve saying she saw me “inside medbay” is either mistaken or a bad interpretation of me being near the entrance/vision edge. I was not in medbay.

The important timing is still: Bob was alive in electrical at ticks 13-14. Charlie admits being in electrical early, and Frank saw Charlie coming from medbay toward upper engine around tick 22. That gives Charlie a later path near the kill area after Bob was alive. My route went weapons -> security -> navigation -> storage, and I ended in storage nowhere near the body.

I get why my wording sounded contradictory, but it’s not a kill confession — it’s a vision/pathing explanation. I still think Charlie has the best opportunity based on the actual death window.
